canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Hiša Franko

parent.title: A Kobarid weekend built around Hiša Franko

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Hiša Franko
siblings.summary: Eight character stays — from the 1861 guesthouse attached to Hiša Franko to a 1000 m chalet quartet with a MICHELIN Key — all reachable by a Soča Valley taxi after dinner.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Hiša Franko
siblings.summary: Half-day and full-day picks around Kobarid — gorges, WWI sites, rafting, alpine drives and artisan food stops — timed to land you back for the 20:00 Hiša Franko seating.

sources.title: Hiša Franko — Stay With Us (official)
sources.claim: Official Hiša Franko rooms policy: dining guests only, one-night max, check-in 16:00–22:00, check-out 11:00, breakfast 8–10, all rooms have AC, no TVs.

sources.title: Soča Valley — Hiša Franko accommodation
sources.claim: Hiša Franko sits in an old farmhouse 3 km west of Kobarid in Staro Selo and offers 10 rooms plus a 4-room depandance — 28 beds total.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hiša Franko Inn reviews
sources.claim: Hiša Franko Inn rates 4.3/5 from 135 Tripadvisor reviews; one guest cites €165/night with breakfast; reviewers say staying is necessary to enjoy dinner fully.

sources.title: Hiša Franko — FAQ (official)
sources.claim: Hiša Franko FAQ: Kobarid bus station is 3 km away; on-demand taxi service is available throughout the Soča Valley; no shuttle is provided.

sources.title: Soča River — Apartment Žonir
sources.claim: Apartment Žonir is at Staro selo 57, sleeps up to 4, has private sauna and large terrace, costs €75–155/night; breakfast is delivered to the apartment at extra cost; Hiša Franko is 'just a few steps' away.

sources.title: Booking.com — Chalet & Apartment Žonir
sources.claim: Chalet and Apartment Žonir with Sauna rates 8.7/10 on Booking.com; guests confirm it is 'within walking distance of a Michelin-starred restaurant'.

sources.title: VisitSoča Kobarid — apartments & transfer taxi
sources.claim: VisitSoča Kobarid operates Apartments Hlapi with SPA (Trg Svobode 14, Kobarid centre), Chalet & Apartment Žonir with Sauna (Staro selo 57), Apartment Honey Bee (Markova 18) and a transfer taxi.

sources.title: Enriching Pursuits — Hiša Franko diner account
sources.claim: First-person diner: on-site rooms were already full when the dining reservation was secured; the Žonir host drove guests to and from Hiša Franko at no extra charge.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Kobarid → Staro Selo
sources.claim: Walking distance Kobarid centre → Staro Selo is roughly 4.4 km / ~53 min; the Nomago bus runs four times daily on weekdays for €3 (5 min); taxi is €14–18.

sources.title: Kraji.eu — Lime Avenue, Kobarid
sources.claim: A lime-tree avenue planted in 1936 lines the road between Kobarid and Staro Selo — the scenic route for the walk.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Staro Selo, Kobarid
sources.claim: Staro Selo is a hamlet of a few dozen houses; 2002 population was 153; church dedicated to St. Leonard.

sources.title: Nebesa Chalets (official)
sources.claim: Nebesa is a four-chalet retreat on a mountain plateau above Livek, built by Ana Roš's parents Katja and Bojan.

sources.title: Host Unusual — Nebesa
sources.claim: Nebesa is 7 km from Kobarid; meals from partner restaurant Hiša Franko can be delivered to the chalet.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotels near Hiša Franko
sources.claim: Tripadvisor's 'closest hotels to Hiša Franko' list: Apartments Pri Nas 2.0 mi (4.6/5), Apartments Masera 2.1 mi (4.7/5), Gostišče Jazbec 2.7 mi (4.5/5), Tourist Farmhouse Kranjc 4.0 mi (4.9/5), Nebesa 4.5 mi (4.9/5).

sources.title: Booking.com — Hisa Rejmr
sources.claim: Hisa Rejmr is a renovated 2-bedroom holiday home in central Kobarid rated 9.7/10 on Booking.com, with breakfast available.

sources.title: Planet of Hotels — Hotel Hvala (Topli Val)
sources.claim: Hotel Hvala (Topli Val) is a family-run hotel 142 m from the centre of Kobarid.

sources.title: Discover Soča Valley — taxi service to Hiša Franko
sources.claim: Discover Soča Valley taxi will collect diners, wait through the 3–4 hour meal and return them to their accommodation.

sources.title: Hiša Franko (official)
sources.claim: Hiša Franko, run by chef Ana Roš in Staro Selo near Kobarid, holds three Michelin stars and a Green Star.
